item.title: Families in metro Detroit struggle to reach loved ones as internet goes dark in Iran
item.description: Iranian Americans in the metro Detroit area say they have been unable to reach family and friends in Iran since U.S. and Israeli strikes killed the country's supreme leader.

item.title: Sumpter Township declares emergency over hazardous gravel roads, calls on Wayne County to act
item.description: Sumpter Township officials are demanding Wayne County take immediate action to repair what they describe as nearly impassable gravel roads, declaring a public safety emergency.

item.title: Anti-war protesters rally at Michigan Capitol, support War Powers Resolution
item.description: From our nation’s Capitol to our state Capitol, Lansing joined the dozens of cities across the country in what organizers called a coordinated day of action.
